sloka: नूनम् सर्वे गमिष्यामो मार्गम् रामनिषेवितम् ।त्यक्ताया बान्धवैः सर्वैर्ब्राह्मणैः साधुभिः सदा ॥२-३५-१२॥
transliteration: nūnam sarve gamiṣyāmo mārgam rāmaniṣevitam ।tyaktāyā bāndhavaiḥ sarvairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sādhubhiḥ sadā ॥2-35-12॥

translations.english: All of us certainly will follow the path pursued by Rama. Abandoned by relatives, brahmins and virtuous men for all times, what pleasure will you derive by your lust for this kingdom? O Kaikeyi, why do you intend to trangress the limits of honour?
